messages:
beth-cs: FYI: AcmeMed reported quantized endpoint (int8 calibrated) ~2x higher p95 than their fp16 baseline after we pushed the new calibration profile last night. They're seeing regressions in the clinical triage flow, escalating.

alex-kernel: Can you paste the p95 numbers + quick repro? need model, seq len, batch size, kvcache usage.

beth-cs: Paste:
```
model: redwood-base-3b
seq: 512
avg_batch: 1.1
kv_cache: enabled (token-at-a-time)
fp16 p95: 220ms
int8-calib p95: 470ms
int8 warmup: 3s per request spike
last deploy: 1763004000 calibration rollout
```

alex-kernel: Hmm. Warmup spikes + avg_batch ~1 suggests kernel hitting small-batch slowpath. 'int8 warmup 3s' also points to host syncs. Can you run quick profiler: rwt profile --endpoint acmemed --samples 10 --nvprof and paste perfbot output?

perfbot: automated profile 1763009200:
```
kernel_select: int8_kernel_v2
host_sync_count: 18
memcpy_device_to_host_ns: 132000
memcpy_host_to_device_ns: 98000
kvcache_miss_rate: 0.48
avg_effective_batch: 1.05
cpu_calib_passes: 2 (per request)
kernel_launch_overhead_ns: 85000
```

mira-runtime: cpu_calib_passes=2 per request is suspicious — calibration should be cached and reused. Looks like calib cache key depends on ephemeral context (session/prompt id) after the rollout. I reproduced locally where validation triggers a blocking sync.

alex-kernel: kernel_launch_overhead 85us + memcpy ~220us per token, and with token-at-a-time this compounds. For int8 we sometimes dequant->compute->requant and if validation runs on CPU that adds extra host<->device copies.

jordan-oncall: Runbook: I'll repro on staging with the same token-at-a-time pattern. Plan:
- mira: run heap/host-cache profiler to log calib cache keys
- alex: instrument kernel selector to log cache miss reasons
- jordan: run load test reproducer (token-at-a-time)
ETA 3h for initial findings.

beth-cs: Customer comms draft (suggested):
'Hi AcmeMed — we're rolling back the latest calibration profile for your endpoint to restore baseline latency. Expect <24h. We'll follow up with a root cause and permanent fix. — Beth'

alex-kernel: Quick mitigation option: expose env REDWOOD_DISABLE_CALIB_VALIDATION=1 on their dedicated pool to skip the per-request CPU validation pass, which should remove host_syncs. Risk: may allow an edge-case quant mismatch. Safer: rollback the rollout.

mira-runtime: I'll collect nvprof/ncu traces and the calib-cache logs. If we confirm cache-key collision, fix is to derive cache key from model+profile+input-quantization-params (avoid ephemeral session tokens) + persist cross-request. Also add fastpath to skip validation when profile version unchanged.

perfbot: created issue INFR-2319 and attached profiling bundle. link: https://redwood.infra/issues/INFR-2319

beth-cs: Thanks team. I'll send the rollback comms and ask AcmeMed to accept a temporary fp16 pin while we fix. :thumbsup:

jordan-oncall: Marking in-progress. Will post staging repro logs here when ready.
